newsitem.title: SUDAN: Sudan says February y/y inflation drops to 92 pct.
newsitem.headline: Sudan says February y/y inflation drops to 92 pct.

text.p: Sudan said its year on year inflation rate fell to 92 percent in February from 100 percent in January.
State television quoted Finance Minister Abdel Wahhab Osman on Sunday as saying the drop was a result of the ministry's rationalisation and non-reliance on the banking system to pay off debts.
The government has imposed a tight monetary regime and curbed spending in almost every department. In recent months, it has been reporting success in its fight against inflation.
